title: How a teen founder built Affistash: validate the idea, network, and automate affiliate recruitment
summary: Third-person write-up of a podcast interview with Vic about building Affistash, an AI affiliate recruitment tool, as a teenager. Covers validating the idea through community engagement, choosing a passionate niche, networking and mentorship, and where automation is taking affiliate marketing. Vic's own words are paraphrased, not quoted.

principles.text: Validate the idea with real people in the community before building the product.
principles.quote: Vic details his market research approach, validating Afstache as an affiliate recruitment software through community engagement.

principles.text: Pick a niche you are passionate about, then validate the product and find mentors.
principles.quote: emphasizes choosing a passionate niche, product validation, and mentorship.

principles.text: Networking and pursuing your passion matter as much as the product itself.
principles.quote: emphasizing the importance of idea validation, networking, and pursuing one's passion.

principles.text: Expect affiliate work (recruiting, onboarding, commissions) to be increasingly automated with AI.
principles.quote: Giurgiu foreseeing increased automation and AI integration in recruitment, onboarding, and data analysis.

principles.text: Keep refining the product and landing page relentlessly, even late at night.
principles.quote: He emphasizes the dedication required to keep refining and improving the tool, a testament to his commitment to excellence.
